messages:
laura: Heads-up — we just saw a console session where the filters showed another workspace's saved searches for ~2s during a workspace switch. Not full data dump but definitely wrong rows. :grimacing:
raj: omg, repro steps?
laura: Steps: user A is in org-42, clicks quick-switch -> org-99, very fast. Console prefetch kicks in, quick-switch UI shows results from org-42 briefly, then flips to org-99. Screenshot attached.
sam: Is this the same prefetch cache we disabled last week for canary?
laura: Similar codepath, but this looks like a label/tag collision in our route affinity cache. The tenant label on the cached response was empty for some requests and the route mux fell back to default tenant.
casey: Can you paste the header logs? I want to see X-Workspace / X-Tenant headers.
laura: log excerpt:
```
INCOMING /api/search 200ms X-Org: 42 X-User: laura
PREFETCH cache-hit key=search:org::quick:42 -> tenant_label=""
ROUTER route->console-v2 tenant_label_lookup=fallback(org-42)
```
raj: That empty tenant_label is suspicious. Where could empty get in? migration to affinity v2?
casey: affinity v2 sets tenant_label on request context in middleware. If context lost during async prefetch it could default to empty string. We saw similar in 172... bug but not identical.
sam: Could be a race between cookie-based session and prefetch header injection. Quick-switch flow spawns a background prefetch request without binding the request context.
laura: Agreed. Impact estimate: low frequency but visible to user -> security/privacy concern. We should treat as P1 for isolation.
casey: Propose quick mitigation: make prefetch request include explicit org header and reject cache entries with empty tenant_label. I can draft PR.
raj: Also we need telemetry: add a telemetry counter for "prefetch.empty_tenant_label" and spike alert if > 10/hour.
laura: +1. Put a small dashboard panel on console-metrics so support can find affected sessions.
ciara-bot: created ticket PE-4092: "prefetch: empty tenant_label leads to transient cross-tenant UI" assigned to casey, priority P1.
casey: I'll push a hotfix branch: `prefetch/explicit-tenant` that rejects empty tenant_label and attaches X-Org header. Will run canary to prod-canary via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued for `prefetch/explicit-tenant` -> staging. sha=ab12cd34
sam: Longer term: we should audit all background work that inherits context. Maybe add linter to prevent middleware-free goroutines.
raj: Also revisit cache key: current key uses `search:org::quick:${userId}` — there's an extra colon; maybe that allows empty org to collide. Fixing key format is cheap.
laura: Good catch. Add to PR: normalize key and reject empty org keys.
casey: Will update PR. I'll add telemetry for key format mismatches too.
laura: OK owners: casey (fix + PR), raj (telemetry + dashboard), sam (postmortem & lint task). Timeline: hotfix today -> canary + monitor for 1h -> rollout.
sam: I'll set up the postmortem template and link the telemetry.
laura: Thanks. If anyone sees more reproductions, drop here or tag me. :eyes:
